usedFor: Sendme keeps contacts, and “New or Update Contact” starts a template when one is created or updated.

bestTemplate.name: “New or Update Contact” in Sendme, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Your team hears about each new or changed contact in a channel.

watchOut: “New or Update Contact” in Sendme is polling and fires on updates too, so expect repeats.
